column9: Official Journal of the European Union EN C series C/2026/3880 20.7.2026 COUNCIL DECISION of 10 July 2026 replacing a member of the Management Board of the European Foundation for the improvement of living and working conditions for Denmark (C/2026/3880) THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION, Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Having regard to Regulation (EU) 2019/127 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 January 2019 establishing the European Foundation for the improvement of living and working conditions (Eurofound), and repealing Council Regulation (EEC) No 1365/75 ( 1 ) , and in particular Article 4 thereof, Whereas: (1) By Decision of 28 March 2023 ( 2 ) , the Council appointed members and alternate members of the Management Board of the European Foundation for the improvement of living and working conditions for the period from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2027. (2) A seat as member in the representatives of employers’ organisations category has fallen vacant as a result of the resignation of Ms Christiane MIßLBECK-WINBERG. (3) The employers’ organisation BusinessEurope has designated a candidate for the vacant seat, HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION: Article 1 Mr Martin Steen KABONGO is appointed member of the Management Board of the European Foundation for the improvement of living and working conditions in place of Ms Christiane MIßLBECK-WINBERG for the remainder of the current term of office, ending on 31 March 2027. Article 2 This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption. Done at Brussels, 10 July 2026. For the Council The President S. HARRIS ( 1 ) OJ L 30, 31.1.2019, p. 74 . ( 2 ) Council Decision of 28 March 2023 appointing members and alternate members of the Management Board of the European Foundation for the improvement of living and working conditions (Eurofound) ( OJ C 116, 31.3.2023, p. 23 ).
